referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset represents the production of 1 m³ of precast geopolymer concrete pipe in Germany. The dataset includes all waste treatment processes arising from the production phase at the precast plant. The end-of-life treatment of the pipe itself (e.g., demolition, recycling, disposal) is not included and must be accounted for in downstream processes that use this dataset as an input.
